description: You are the General Operations Manager at a consulting firm processing the results of the annual personnel review. Several role changes must be implemented in the HR system before the end of the week. Log in to Odoo at http://localhost:8069 with username admin and password admin. Implement the following changes: (1) Promote Ronnie Hart: change their Job Position to 'CTO', move them to the 'Management' department, and set 'Marc Demo' as their direct manager. (2) Change Jennie Fletcher's Job Position to 'HR Manager'. (3) For every employee currently in the 'Long Term Projects' department, add the 'Consultant' tag if they do not already have it. (4) Set 'Randall Lewis' as the official department manager (not just their personal manager) of the 'Long Term Projects' department.
